rules.statement: The Court of Appeal will intervene in revision only if there is fundamental vice and to avert a miscarriage of justice, even when the law stipulates finality and conclusiveness to decrees under partition laws.
rules.supporting_quote: "Yet the Court will intervene in revision only if there is fundamental vice and to avert a miscarriage of justice: 300"
